name: Sewer Meat
source:
Sewer Meat is a miniature Visual Novel for PC and Android. It features the big, muscley Chris getting used up in a horror-inspired, dank sewer setting.

[Edited from [url=https://hotcha.gumroad.com/l/IYMUS]Gumroad[/url]]
translation:
《下水道肉》是一款适用于PC和Android的微型视觉小说。影片讲述了身材高大、肌肉发达的克里斯在一个恐怖的、潮湿的下水道环境中筋疲力尽的故事。

[编辑自[url=https://hotcha.gumroad.com/l/IYMUS]Gumroad[/url]]
